title: Do any three longest paths in a connected graph have a vertex in common?

model_contract.hypothesis: G is a finite connected graph and P1,P2,P3 are longest paths.
model_contract.conclusion: P1, P2, and P3 share a vertex.
model_contract.counterexample_condition: G is a finite connected graph and P1,P2,P3 are longest paths. and NOT (P1, P2, and P3 share a vertex.)
model_contract.witness: A canonical graph and three maximum-length paths with empty triple intersection.
